items.question: Do I need Meta's official API to get started?
items.answer: No. You can start today with the number you already use, with no approval wait. When it makes sense for your business, you can migrate to WhatsApp's official API.

items.question: Is my data and my customers' data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Messages and personal data are protected, and every account's data is isolated from other Sales Flow customers.

items.question: Can I use the number I already use today?
items.answer: Yes. You don't need to switch numbers or migrate your contact base to start using Sales Flow.

items.question: Do I need to know how to code or handle tech stuff?
items.answer: No. The dashboard was built for business owners and support teams to set up on their own, no developer needed.
